tasks.title: Creator Studio Development Tracker and mandatory step-completion workflow
tasks.description: Build a read-only visual development dashboard, snapshot builder, canonical step-level tracker and mandatory reviewed-step protocol. ChatGPT reviews steps and, under Lukas's explicit standing delegation, handles routine task PR opening/merging and lease release; Claude never self-approves, merges PRs or releases leases; Lukas retains final authority. Does not change milestone weights, scores or the governance package.
acceptance_criteria: dashboard/index.html is a responsive read-only page showing implementation and verification progress, milestones by phase, the current task and its steps (status, acceptance criteria, evidence), open decisions, blockers, next actions, GitHub branch/PR/merge information, an explicit completion gate with a terminal-clear status, and the snapshot commit SHA and generation time; it never writes project status

DEVELOPMENT_TRACKER.json holds canonical step-level tracking (id, title, status, acceptance criteria, evidence, completion state) linked to ACTIVE_TASKS task IDs; it does not duplicate or recalculate milestone progress or task leases

dashboard/build_snapshot.py uses only the Python standard library, records source commit SHA, branch, generation time and working-tree cleanliness, and includes no secrets, credentials, private local paths or footage; an old snapshot is never presented as live GitHub data

DEVELOPMENT_STEP_PROTOCOL.md defines the one-step-at-a-time rule: stop at READY_FOR_REVIEW, report changes/tests/evidence/unresolved issues/terminal safety, ChatGPT reviews and either asks for corrections or gives written technical approval, which may authorize the next step under Lukas's standing instruction; ChatGPT handles task PR opening/merging and lease release under Lukas's explicit delegation (Claude never self-approves, merges PRs or releases leases; Lukas retains final authority); no automatic task switching
PROJECT_OPERATING_PROTOCOL.md and CLAUDE.md require every future session to follow the step protocol
Tests verify tracker structure, step transitions, snapshot generation and completion-gate behavior
Milestone weights and computed progress in PROJECT_STATUS.json are unchanged by this task; no GitHub credentials appear in browser JavaScript; the repository stays private; no new dependencies
